project-kickoff-meeting-agenda-template.0: A project kickoff meeting sets the tone for everything after it. Done well, it sends the team out with the same picture of the goal, scope and timeline, with every person clear on who does what. Done badly? Misunderstandings show up 6 weeks later as scope creep and missed dates.
project-kickoff-meeting-agenda-template.1: Use this project kickoff meeting agenda template for a proven structure, versions for internal and client kickoffs, a filled-in sample, and a checklist for the hour after the meeting.

project-kickoff-meeting-agenda-template.4: Copy this project kickoff meeting agenda template for an internal team kickoff. Runtime: 60 minutes.
project-kickoff-meeting-agenda-template.6: Why the approval process item? It prevents the most common agency problem: work waiting days for feedback from someone who was never named.
project-kickoff-meeting-agenda-template.7: Below is a filled-in project kickoff meeting agenda example for a website redesign. Company and names: placeholders.
project-kickoff-meeting-agenda-template.8: Most project kickoff meetings run 60 minutes for internal projects and 60 to 90 minutes for client projects. Very large ones? Sometimes a half-day workshop, split into sessions with breaks.
project-kickoff-meeting-agenda-template.9: Keep it short. Send a pre-read 2 days before (the project brief, scope draft and timeline), then use the meeting itself to discuss and decide rather than to read slides together.
project-kickoff-meeting-agenda-template.10: Invite everyone who will do significant work on the project, the sponsor who owns the goal, and anyone who must approve deliverables. Aim for 5 to 10 people. Above 12? Discussion becomes a presentation.
project-kickoff-meeting-agenda-template.13: Let AI capture the kickoff, and the project lead can focus on facilitating. Decisions about scope and timeline get recorded, actions get listed with owners, and a searchable record stays ready for when someone asks "did we agree to that?" in week 6.
project-kickoff-meeting-agenda-template.14: See how product teams turn [meeting minutes into Jira issues](https://lynkk.ai/blog/meeting-minutes-to-jira), or read our [meeting agenda template in Word](https://lynkk.ai/blog/meeting-agenda-template-word) for general agenda tips.
project-kickoff-meeting-agenda-template.15: Introductions and roles, background and goals, scope, deliverables and timeline, ways of working, risks and dependencies, open questions, and next steps with owners. Send the agenda early. With a pre-read 1 to 2 days before, the meeting is spent discussing scope and risks instead of reading slides together.
project-kickoff-meeting-agenda-template.18: To align everyone on the goal, scope, timeline, roles and ways of working before work starts, so the project avoids misunderstandings later. Skip scope or owners and it usually shows up weeks later. Scope creep. Missed dates. Arguments about what was agreed.
